text:
The plate looks like a side plate of about 20 cm, since its outer diameter spans roughly 450 px.

The food is two shrimp summer rolls (fresh rolls) and two small pieces of fried shrimp toast, or possibly sugarcane shrimp.

Each roll is about 11 cm long and 3 cm wide. Fresh rolls like these weigh about 40-50 g each, so the two come to about 90 g and about 80 kcal each, or about 160 kcal.

The two fried pieces are small, about 4 cm each, and weigh about 15 g each, so about 30 g. At about 60 kcal each, that is about 120 kcal.

Total mass is about 120 g and total energy is about 280 kcal.
